title: Add Structured Request Logger with Correlation IDs
description: Provides automatic request/response logging with a unique correlation ID per request, improving observability and debugging in production. The logger is configurable, can be injected with a custom logger, and skips static asset routes to reduce noise.
testCases: Verify that each incoming request receives a X-Correlation-ID header when none is supplied
Verify that the logger outputs a JSON line containing method, url, status, response time, and correlation ID
Ensure that static file routes are excluded from logging when configured
Confirm that a custom logger injected via app.useLogger() receives the same log entries
acceptance: All test cases pass; the middleware adds a correlation ID header if missing, logs structured JSON entries for each request (excluding configured skip paths), and allows injection of a custom logger without affecting existing routing or error handling.
reason: Improves production monitoring and traceability, reduces time to diagnose issues, and aligns yantraverse with modern observability best practices without adding external dependencies.
